title: PARAM- parameter value of one FORM slot v1 (DRAFT_PENDING_H4)
description: schema_version 1.0.0-draft. STATUS DRAFT_PENDING_H4: not approved, not frozen, not copied into ledgers/schemas/. AI draft of worker ksh (S159), reviewed afterwards by Kush and Parv (D-045). FORM- versus MODEL- prefix (Step 24f, H4) is OPEN: the id pattern accepts both and the validator (culinarystate.mechanism.form_param_val) checks against the prefix the caller names. Step 24a schema, field list Part J1 J1.3.5 (rows are written by 24b / 26d only from verified K1+ series). UNKNOWN is a valid value; no default value exists.
$comment: Shared $defs and envelope fields copied verbatim from KIN.draft_v1_1.schema.json. Rules: no PARAM from K0 aggregates; no cross-order unit harmonisation (unit dimension checked against the FORM slot by the validator); no cross-study pooling without a hierarchical fit; origin AUTHOR_REPORTED and PROJECT_REFIT never conflated.

value_si.description: SI value as a SEPARATE field (raw value and unit in `value` are never rewritten), as KIN keeps raw time and normalised seconds apart.

value_provenance.description: Where the value comes from. AUTHOR_REPORTED: the KIN series and the index of the author fit in KIN.fit. PROJECT_REFIT: the KIN series and the 26a fit_run_id (content id of the fit inputs). UNKNOWN only with an UNKNOWN value: a number without provenance is rejected (origin values are never conflated, J1.3.5).

partition.description: Assigned from the Step-15 partitions before fitting; PENDING_15B until 15b exists.

allOf.description: A parameter is a point (MEASURED = point-value shape), an interval (RANGE) or UNKNOWN.

value_obj.description: UNKNOWN-aware value (same status vocabulary as ledgers/schemas/common QVALUE). A number is allowed only where the status says so; UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE/QUALITATIVE/CENSORED carry no number (the censoring limit lives in `censoring`). `raw` keeps the source string verbatim. `unit` is the raw unit string as printed and is never rewritten; `unit_id` (UNIT-) is the optional normalised pointer with an explicit mapping status (NOT_MAPPED / UNKNOWN keep it null; never a guessed id).

dispersion.description: Dispersion with its TYPE always stated (SD vs SE vs CI cannot be confused). NONE_REPORTED = source gives none; UNKNOWN = not assessed. Estimates from median/range (Wan et al. 2014 type) are allowed only with derivation ESTIMATED_FROM_SUMMARY, never as AS_REPORTED. `unit` null means 'same unit as the value' (VARIANCE: squared unit, state it). `n_basis` says which n the SD/SE refers to (biological vs technical; needed for SE->SD conversion; NOT_REPORTED = source silent, UNKNOWN = not assessed). `scope` PER_VALUE vs POOLED_TABLE (one pooled SEM / LSD for a whole table). `significance_raw` keeps significance letters / p text verbatim. CV_PERCENT is stored as printed (unit '%'), never converted to an SD here.

count.description: Replicate/sample count with explicit status. NOT_REPORTED = the source was read and is silent; UNKNOWN = not assessed or cannot be told. Never 0 and never a default 1.

locator.description: Exact place in a DOC. raw_text is the verbatim cell/span/row (key required, null only when the source has no text form).

matrix.description: Same facets as EVD.matrix (non-destructive). raw_name is required (raw preserved); ingredient_id null = UNRESOLVED.

process.description: Process as in EVD.process; process_id null = UNRESOLVED.

time_conversion.description: Normalised seconds as a SEPARATE field with a conversion status; the raw time value, raw unit token and printed unit label are never rewritten. s / min / h / d / week convert exactly (CONVERTED_EXACT); month and year are calendar durations and are NEVER exact: they stay NOT_CONVERTED, or are converted only under a stated convention (CONVERTED_BY_STATED_CONVENTION, convention text mandatory, e.g. '1 month = 30 d'); unit OTHER / UNKNOWN is not converted. Seconds are never produced from an unknown unit and never defaulted to 0 (07H-R lesson: calendar conversion at ingest was a failure class).

k_level.description: KIN k_level vocabulary; K0 is excluded (no PARAM from K0 aggregates, SSOT 211.48).

fitted_on.description: Calibration context with the KIN lineage key names (study <= lineage root <= split group <= lab group, evidence plane only).

design_point.description: One design / condition point: a temperature (value_obj, raw unit kept) and the raw process times at it (clock PROCESS_TAU, raw time unit as in KIN.time_base.unit).

tau_range.description: Raw time range with the KIN clock and unit vocabulary; seconds are separate time_conversion fields (month / year never exact).
